svg.title: Parallel Execution
svg.desc: Repository documentation. Recreated from Authoring.md, section Parallel Execution, original lines 252–258. All labels and relationships are preserved from that document; this illustration does not independently assert implementation status. Original textual diagram: Level 0: fetch-data fetch-config ↓ ↘ ↓ Level 1: validate transform ↓ ↓ Level 2: load The SVG follows the adjacent YAML: fetch-data → validate; fetch-data and fetch-config → transform; validate and transform → load.
